summary: Iteration 78 - CamScanner with NEW SYNCHRONOUS ScannerEngine (no Worker). ALL 15 TESTS PASS. Architecture change validated: removed Web Worker entirely, using pure JS ScannerEngine class with synchronous operations. SCAN/FILTER/ROTATE/CROP all complete in <10ms. Console shows SCAN START/DONE, FILTER START/DONE, ROTATE START/DONE, CROP START/DONE - NO Worker-related logs (correct for new architecture).

TEST_1_SCANNER_OPENS.details: Scanner opens from /dossier-express, guide phase shows with scanner-ready-badge: 'Cadrage automatique + correction perspective actives'

TEST_2_FILE_UPLOAD.details: Upload test image via scanner-file-btn, preview shows immediately with step-log: 'Image traitee'. Console shows: SCAN START / SCAN DONE 8 ms

TEST_3_ALL_BUTTONS_ENABLED.details: After image ready, all 7 buttons are ENABLED (no opacity-30/opacity-40): filter-bw, filter-document, filter-original, rotate-left-btn, rotate-right-btn, manual-crop-btn, adjust-toggle-btn

TEST_4_FILTER_BW.details: Click filter-bw, button highlights green (bg-emerald-500), step-log: 'Filtre Noir & Blanc (3ms)'. Console: FILTER START: bw / FILTER DONE 1 ms

TEST_5_FILTER_ORIGINAL.details: Click filter-original, button highlights green, step-log: 'Filtre Original (1ms)'. Console: FILTER START: original / FILTER DONE 1 ms

TEST_6_FILTER_CONTRASTE_PLUS.details: Click filter-document, button highlights green, step-log: 'Filtre Contraste+ (2ms)'. Console: FILTER START: document / FILTER DONE 1 ms

TEST_7_ROTATE_LEFT.details: Click rotate-left-btn, step-log: 'Rotation gauche (3ms)'. Console: ROTATE START: left / ROTATE DONE 2 ms

TEST_8_ROTATE_RIGHT.details: Click rotate-right-btn, step-log: 'Rotation droite (2ms)'. Console: ROTATE START: right / ROTATE DONE 2 ms

TEST_9_CROP.details: Click manual-crop-btn, corner-adjuster visible with 4 corner handles, manual-mode-badge shows 'Deplacez les coins', click apply-crop-btn, step-log: 'Recadrage applique (2ms)'. Console: CROP START / CROP DONE 1 ms

TEST_10_ADJUST.details: Click adjust-toggle-btn, adjust-panel opens with brightness-slider and contrast-slider visible

TEST_11_SAVE.details: Click preview-confirm-btn (Valider / Sauvegarder), finalizing phase triggered (fast completion)

TEST_12_MULTI_PAGE.details: Upload first image (red), click preview-add-page-btn (via evaluate), page-counter shows '1', camera phase with 'Page 2' text visible, upload second image (blue), preview-finish-btn shows 'Terminer (2 pages)'. NOTE: Must use page.evaluate() to click add-page button for React handler to fire.

TEST_13_NO_CANVAS_ERROR.details: Zero 'getImageData: source width is 0' errors in console. Canvas guards in scannerEngine.js: line 25-28 check sourceCanvas.width/height before processing.

TEST_14_NO_HANGING.details: All operations < 10ms: SCAN 4-8ms, FILTER 1-3ms, ROTATE 2-3ms, CROP 1-2ms. No Worker init delay. Operations are SYNCHRONOUS on main thread.

TEST_15_CLOSE.details: Click scanner-close, scanner closes successfully, document-scanner element no longer visible

added: synchronous methods: scan(), applyFilter(), rotate(), crop(), adjust()
key_differences: No Worker init delay - engine instantiated with useRef
All operations synchronous - no async/await for image processing
On engine error, falls back to fallbackEnhance()

notes: HTML hydration warnings for span in option/select are unrelated to scanner - from DossierExpressPage form
Camera access fails in Playwright test environment (expected) - shows 'Aucune camera. Utilisez la galerie.'
Multi-page test requires page.evaluate() for button click to trigger React handler - Playwright click(force=True) doesn't work

critical_code_review_comments: ScannerEngine class properly guards against invalid canvas: line 25-28 checks sourceCanvas.width/height
All engine methods return null on !this.ready, preventing getImageData errors
Filter highlighting: filter === f.id && canEdit for bg-emerald-500
Rotation properly updates originalData after transform
Crop uses normalized coords {x0, y0, x1, y1} with Math.min/max for bounds
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_image_1.jpg (300x200 red) and /tmp/test_image_2.jpg (400x300 blue) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 78 validates the MAJOR ARCHITECTURE CHANGE: removed Web Worker, using pure JS ScannerEngine class. All 15 scanner tests pass.
